newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca says has no place in Busang lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Minorca says has no place in Busang lawsuit.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc has no reason to be included in a threatened lawsuit over the rich Busang gold deposit in Indonesia, Minorca chief executive Roland Horst said Friday.
"I'm not sure why we're involved," Horst said in a phone interview.

Minorca, which has a small interest through an Indonesian company in the Busang deposit, was named in a letter to Bre-X Minerals Ltd from PT Krueng Gasui, another Indonesian company which is claiming up to 40 percent of the entire Busang discovery.
Krueng Gasui has threatened to sue for more than US$1.9 billion if Bre-X does not meet with its lawyers to find a solution. Bre-X has said it will set up a meeting.
Krueng Gasui has not contacted Minorca directly about the threat, Horst said.
"I think the important thing is that Bre-X has agreed to attend the meeting," he said. "We'll watch the outcome of that meeting with great interest."
